Beyond the Words.

The Journey of becoming.

From a childhood dream of becoming a writer arose a greater aspiration to establish a publishing house, which led to the founding of The Alcove Publishers in March 2016.

What began as a dedicated space for authors has now evolved into a larger dream, The Alcove Worldwide, a dynamic ecosystem encompassing media, digital studios, children’s imprints, and lifestyle ventures.

Alongside ventures like Namobharattimes.com, The Alcove Digital Studio and The Alcove Tigers, DPN dedicates her time to her campaign – Shakthi – Building a strong nation by empowering children emotionally and physically.

An influencer and storyteller, she also finds peace and purpose in service. She serves as Joint Secretary of Canserve, an organisation based in Kerala dedicated to supporting cancer patients in need.

A proud nationalist, she takes immense pride in being an inseparable part of India. Her commitment to working for the nation and its people remains an integral part of who she is.

DPN draws her strength from a deep sense of spirituality and an ongoing journey of self-awakening, guided by the philosophy of Tat Tvam Asi — That Thou Art. An athlete and marathon runner, she believes in the power of inner strength, self-discipline and the pursuit of one’s fullest potential.

Ventures

One vision, many creative worlds: publishing, media, digital, children’s content and lifestyle.

The Alcove Worldwide

A creative enterprise bringing together publishing, digital innovation, media, and learning under one vision. It aims to build brands, nurture talent, amplify voices, and create opportunities beyond geographical boundaries.

The Alcove Publishers

An independent publishing house committed to discovering exceptional voices, nurturing emerging writers, and bringing meaningful stories to readers across the world.

The Alcove Digital Studio

A digital solutions and marketing division for websites, SEO, digital marketing, social media, content writing, and author websites, built on over a decade of experience.

The Alcove Tigers

The children’s imprint of The Alcove Publishers, nurturing emotional intelligence, confidence, curiosity, leadership, and resilience through stories and life skills.

Namobharat Times

A digital news and media platform bringing relevant stories, ideas, and perspectives to a global audience, with a focus on readers in the United States and Europe.

WhisB Décor

Wooden furniture and home décor designed for children, and home to WhisB – The Blue Bird, a children’s series that introduces life’s lessons through conversational stories.
